argument.root_pretty:
∀ {S : Type uS} {A : Type uA} {Y : Type uY} [inst : Fintype Y] (K : AuditCP.AuditChannel S A Y),
  AuditCP.AuditSealed K ↔ ∀ (s : S) (a a' : A), AuditCP.equalPriorBayesError (K (s, a)) (K (s, a')) = 1 / 2

leaves.doc:
B6 — `AuditChannel S A Y` is `AuditExperiment (S × A) Y`, an experiment whose parameter is
split into a public coordinate `S` and an audit coordinate `A`.
leaves.pretty: AuditCP.AuditIndex → AuditCP.AuditIndex → AuditCP.AuditIndex → Type (max u v w)

leaves.doc:
The channel `K` is audit-sealed: its output law at fixed public state `s` does not depend on
the audit state `a`.
leaves.pretty: {S : Type uS} → {A : Type uA} → {Y : Type uY} → AuditCP.AuditChannel S A Y → Prop

leaves.doc: The equal-prior Bayes error between `p` and `q`, `(1/2) * ∑ y, min (pmfMass p y) (pmfMass q y)`.
leaves.pretty: {Y : Type uY} → [Fintype Y] → PMF Y → PMF Y → ℝ

leaves.doc:
The total variation distance between `p` and `q`, half the `ℓ¹` distance of their point
masses, `(1/2) * ∑ y, |pmfMass p y - pmfMass q y|`.
leaves.pretty: {Y : Type uY} → [Fintype Y] → PMF Y → PMF Y → ℝ

leaves.doc: The real-valued point mass of `y` under the Mathlib `PMF` `p`, `(p y).toReal`.
leaves.pretty: {Y : Type uY} → PMF Y → Y → ℝ

nodes.doc: F3 — `AuditSealed K ↔ ∀ s a a', equalPriorBayesError (K (s, a)) (K (s, a')) = 1/2`.
nodes.pretty:
∀ {S : Type uS} {A : Type uA} {Y : Type uY} [inst : Fintype Y] (K : AuditCP.AuditChannel S A Y),
  AuditCP.AuditSealed K ↔ ∀ (s : S) (a a' : A), AuditCP.equalPriorBayesError (K (s, a)) (K (s, a')) = 1 / 2
∀ {Y : Type uY} [inst : Fintype Y] (p q : PMF Y), AuditCP.equalPriorBayesError p q = 1 / 2 ↔ p = q
∀ {Y : Type uY} [inst : Fintype Y] (p q : PMF Y), AuditCP.finiteTotalVariation p q = 0 ↔ p = q

nodes.doc: F3a — `equalPriorBayesError p q = (1 - finiteTotalVariation p q) / 2`.
nodes.pretty:
∀ {Y : Type uY} [inst : Fintype Y] (p q : PMF Y),
  AuditCP.equalPriorBayesError p q = (1 - AuditCP.finiteTotalVariation p q) / 2

nodes.doc: On a finite type, the real point masses of `p` sum to `1`.
nodes.pretty: ∀ {Y : Type uY} [inst : Fintype Y] (p : PMF Y), ∑ y, AuditCP.pmfMass p y = 1
∀ (x y : ℝ), min x y = (x + y - |x - y|) / 2
